chunks: And Ḥammād narrated from Ḥarīz, from al-Fuḍayl or someone else, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, the grandfather is a partner with the siblings, and his share is like the share of one of them, however many they may be, whether many or few.

key_terms.الْجَدَّ: the grandfather as an inheriting relative
key_terms.حَظُّهُ: his assigned share of the estate
key_terms.حَظِّ أَحَدِهِمْ: the portion equal to that of one sibling
key_terms.شَرِيكُ الْإِخْوَةِ: sharing inheritance together with the siblings

ai.seo_question: How is the grandfather’s inheritance share calculated alongside siblings in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance, stating that the grandfather shares alongside the siblings. His allotted portion is equal to the share of one sibling, regardless of the number of siblings involved.
